DICEVISION.Settings.SessionCode.Name: Session Code
DICEVISION.Settings.SessionCode.Hint: 8-character code from DiceVision Settings (e.g. XKRM-4N7B). Create one at dicevision.dirtyowlbear.com. The camera tab in the sidebar connects too.
DICEVISION.Settings.Mode.Name: Operating Mode
DICEVISION.Settings.Mode.Hint: How recognized dice rolls are handled in Foundry. Replace: every roll (/roll, character sheets) waits for your physical dice while connected; Core › Dice Configuration can still set individual die types (or its Default) to another method.
DICEVISION.Settings.Mode.Replace: Replace — Use physical dice for Foundry rolls
DICEVISION.Settings.Continuous.Name: Continuous Mode
DICEVISION.Settings.Continuous.Hint: Chat and Replace mode. Post every physical roll to chat, except rolls a Foundry roll dialog is waiting for. Keeps the DiceVision dashboard capturing continuously. When off, use the dice button by the chat box (or /dv roll) to ask for one roll at a time.
DICEVISION.Settings.AutoConnect.Name: Auto-Connect
DICEVISION.Settings.AutoConnect.Hint: Automatically connect to DiceVision when the world loads.
DICEVISION.Settings.ChatVisibility.Name: Chat Visibility
DICEVISION.Settings.ChatVisibility.Hint: Chat mode only: who sees the result of DiceVision roll cards. With GM Only or Only Me, other players see that you rolled, not the result. Replace-mode rolls (/roll and sheet rolls) follow Foundry's roll mode, chosen under the chat box.
DICEVISION.Settings.RollLabel.Name: Roll Label
DICEVISION.Settings.RollLabel.Hint: Label displayed on DiceVision roll messages in chat.
DICEVISION.Settings.DiceSoNice.Name: Show 3D Dice (Dice So Nice!)
DICEVISION.Settings.DiceSoNice.Hint: With Dice So Nice! active, show physical DiceVision rolls as 3D dice landing on the faces you rolled, for everyone. Replace-mode rolls animate even with Dice So Nice's "Disabled for manually entered rolls" on. Has no effect without Dice So Nice!.
DICEVISION.Notifications.InvalidSession: DiceVision: Invalid or expired session code
DICEVISION.Notifications.MaxReconnect: DiceVision: Connection lost. Check your session code in the DiceVision sidebar tab.
DICEVISION.Notifications.DisplayFailed: DiceVision: Roll received but could not be posted to chat ({error}). See the console for details.
DICEVISION.Notifications.ModeOff: DiceVision: Mode is set to Off. Use /dv mode replace (or module settings) to roll physical dice for Foundry's rolls, or /dv mode chat to post them to chat.
DICEVISION.Notifications.NoDice: DiceVision: no dice detected. Roll again in view of the camera.
DICEVISION.Notifications.CouldntRead: DiceVision couldn't read {dice}. Roll again, or move it out of the camera's view. Still waiting.
DICEVISION.Notifications.EmptyRoll: DiceVision received a roll with no dice. Roll again. Still waiting.
DICEVISION.Notifications.DialogFailed: DiceVision couldn't update the roll dialog ({error}). Click Submit to roll digitally.
DICEVISION.Notifications.ReplaceDigital: DiceVision Replace mode: Foundry rolls are digital until you reconnect (/dv connect <code>).
DICEVISION.Notifications.ReplaceNotConne: DiceVision Replace mode is on, but DiceVision isn't connecting (no session code, or Auto-Connect is off). Foundry rolls are digital until you connect from the DiceVision sidebar tab or /dv connect <code>.
DICEVISION.Notifications.ApplyFailed: DiceVision: couldn't enter the dice in the roll dialog ({error}). Roll again, or click Submit to roll digitally.
DICEVISION.Notifications.RollIgnored: DiceVision: no Foundry roll is waiting for dice, so this physical roll was ignored.
DICEVISION.Notifications.NotConnected: DiceVision: Not connected. Connect from the DiceVision sidebar tab, or use /dv connect <code>.
DICEVISION.Notifications.ConnectFailed: DiceVision: Could not connect ({error}). Check your session code.
DICEVISION.Notifications.CommandFailed: DiceVision: {command} failed ({error}). See the console for details.
DICEVISION.Controls.RequestRoll: DiceVision: post your next physical roll to chat
DICEVISION.Controls.CancelRequest: DiceVision: waiting for dice (click to cancel)
DICEVISION.Controls.ContinuousActive: DiceVision: continuous mode is posting every roll
DICEVISION.Sidebar.Title: DiceVision
DICEVISION.Sidebar.ConnectHint: From DiceVision Settings at dicevision.dirtyowlbear.com. The dash is optional.
DICEVISION.Sidebar.Roll.Label: Roll physical dice
DICEVISION.Sidebar.Roll.ModeOff: DiceVision: Mode is Off. Set it to Chat or Replace below.
DICEVISION.Commands.Help:
DiceVision commands
/dv roll — post your next physical roll
/dv cancel — cancel a pending roll
/dv continuous [on|off] — post every roll
/dv mode off|chat|replace
/dv connect <code>
/dv disconnect
/dv status
DICEVISION.Commands.NothingToCancel: DiceVision: no roll request to cancel.
DICEVISION.Commands.InvalidCode: DiceVision: "{code}" isn't a session code. Codes are 8 letters or digits, e.g. XKRM-4N7B.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.Label: DiceVision (physical dice)
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.Waiting: DiceVision: roll {dice} in front of your camera. Submit rolls the rest digitally.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.WaitingExtra: DiceVision: roll {dice} in front of your camera. The arrow next to a die rolls it digitally.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.NotConnected: DiceVision is not connected. Click Submit to roll digitally.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.NotConnectedExtra: DiceVision is not connected. Click the arrow next to a die to roll it digitally.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.RolledDigitally: DiceVision: rolled {dice} digitally (DiceVision doesn't support them).
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.Unsupported: DiceVision doesn't support {dice}. Click Submit to roll it digitally.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.UnsupportedExtra: DiceVision doesn't support {dice}. Click the arrow next to it to roll it digitally.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.MissingPair: A d100 needs two d10s, tens and units, rolled together. Got: {dice}.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.EmptyRoll: DiceVision received a roll with no dice. Roll again.
